name: lily-browser
description: A lightweight, polished Chromium-based desktop browser.

scripts.dev: npm run build:main && concurrently -k "vite --host 127.0.0.1" "tsc -p tsconfig.main.json --watch" "wait-on http://127.0.0.1:5173 && cross-env ELECTRON_RENDERER_URL=http://127.0.0.1:5173 electron ."
scripts.build: npm run typecheck && npm run build:renderer && npm run build:main
